text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all her hard work leading up
to this
point, Грасс Вандер claims
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her sights are now set on the Arima
Kinen where
a clash with Марузенски
awaits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Эль Кондор Паса leaves the
venue in a
hurry, almost as if running
away from Grass
Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Emotions whirl as the winds grow colder.
Winter is
on the horizon, but Grass
Wonder's classic year is
far from over
yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
